targets: Explicit provider BallStatus; no missingness-derived D targets. BallStatus and BallPossession never enter features.
features: Only player speed quartiles and spatial spread; centered 0.4/1.6 second summaries. Ball coordinates, velocity, proximity and missingness excluded.
model: L2 logistic regression with training-only median imputation/scaling and explicit missing indicators. Equal fixture contribution, no class reweighting. Deterministic 5 Hz training samples; full 25 Hz evaluation.
corruption: Clean and deterministic label-independent contiguous ball dropout (20 percent of 2-second blocks) plus 20 percent independent player-block dropout. Training seed 731, validation seed 917. Also stress-test 50 percent ball dropout with seed 1123; not a simulation of all real detector errors.
selection: Mean clean/corrupted validation binary dead/live macro F1, then D boundary F1 at 1 second, then combined H/A/D spell F1. Preserve all candidates and source hashes. No selection on the reserved test or supplied fixture.
acceptance: Original D precision/recall/dropout/combined criteria, additionally mean clean onset/restart boundary F1 >=0.5 at one second. Cross-provider partial Metrica check required before promotion.
combined: Keep the externally frozen H/A sequence parameters unchanged; predicted D resets team sequence across stoppage. X never becomes D without classifier evidence.
limits: Provider labels are not challenge ground truth. Corrected/complete external tracking differs from automatic challenge tracking. This experiment does not validate video, automatic Smart Tags, broadcast fusion or final competition performance.
motivation: Previous all-ball-feature experiment exploited exact zero ball velocity throughout provider D intervals. This ablation removes that shortcut; same train/validation fixtures are reused and disclosed.
